shortDescription: RSSB Forester (Vanpal) Answer Key 2026 released around 19–20 July for exam on 28 June 2026 (259 posts).
content:
RSSB has released the Primary Answer Key for Forester 2026 (Advt. 01/2026) around 19–20 July 2026.

Written exam: 28 June 2026. Vacancies: 259.

Download from rssb.rajasthan.gov.in Answer Key section and check objection schedule on the same portal.
